items.title: MenuKeeper
items.text: Keep the order of the manager menu after installing or updating an extra.

items.title: Requirements
items.text:
• MODX Revolution 2.8+
  • PHP 7.4+

items.title: Features
items.text: This extra caches the order of the menu and restores it after the installation or the update of an extra is finished. It also moves new menu entries added during installing a package to the bottom. A snapshot of the menu order can be saved and loaded manually.

items.title: Install from MODX Extras
items.text: Search for MenuKeeper in the Package Manager of your MODX installation and install it in there.

items.title: Manual installation
items.text:
If you can't access the MODX Extras Repository in your MODX installation, you can manually install MenuKeeper.

  • Download the transport package from MODX Extras (or one of the pre built transport packages in _packages)
  • Upload the zip file to your MODX installation's core/packages folder or upload it manually in the MODX Package Manager.
  • In the MODX Manager, navigate to the Package Manager page, and select 'Search locally for packages' from the dropdown button.
  • MenuKeeper should now show up in the list of available packages. Click the corresponding 'Install' button and follow the instructions to complete the installation.

items.title: Build it from source
items.text: To build and install the package from source you could use Git Package Management. The GitHub repository of MenuKeeper contains a config.json to build that package locally. Use this option, if you want to debug MenuKeeper and/or contribute bugfixes and enhancements.

items.title: Usage
items.text: MenuKeeper is active right after the installation. It keeps track of the position of each menu entry and restores the positions after a package installation. New menu entries added during a package installation are moved to the end of their parent menu. That way only newly installed extras change the manager menu.

items.title: Automatic tracking
items.text:
The positions (the parent and the menu index) of all menu entries are cached in a permanent cache. The tracking starts with the first package installation while MenuKeeper is installed. After that, the cache is updated when a manager page is loaded, so changes made in the menu editor are tracked automatically and don't have to be saved manually.

After a package installation, MenuKeeper:

  1. restores the cached positions of the known menu entries,
  2. moves the new menu entries to the end of their parent menu,
  3. caches the resulting positions.

A cached menu entry that was removed in the meantime is skipped.

items.title: Menu Entries
items.text:
The extra adds a MenuKeeper menu with two entries to manually save and load a snapshot of the menu entry positions. The menu is located in the Manage menu, in MODX 3.1 and newer in the Admin (gear) menu. Using the entries requires the settings permission.

Entry Description Save Save a snapshot of the current menu entry positions. Load Restore the menu entry positions of the saved snapshot and reload the manager. The restored positions are also kept after the next package installation.

The snapshot is independent of the automatic tracking, so loading a manager page does not overwrite it. Use it to save a menu order before you try other changes in the menu editor and to return to that order afterward.

items.title: System Settings
items.text:
MenuKeeper uses the following system settings in the namespace menukeeper:

Key Name Description Default menukeeper.cache_permissions Cache Permissions Cache the permissions of each menu entry. No menukeeper.debug Debug Log debug information in the MODX error log. No menukeeper.package_installer_at_top_original Original Installer Position The value of the package_installer_at_top system setting before MenuKeeper was installed. It is restored when MenuKeeper is uninstalled. -

Cache the permissions

If you enable menukeeper.cache_permissions, the permissions of the menu entries are restored after a package installation too. They are cached with the next manager page load. Save a new snapshot with Save, if you want to load the permissions with Load.

Debug

If menukeeper.debug is enabled, MenuKeeper logs the cached, restored and sorted menu entries in the MODX error log.

items.title: Changed MODX System Setting
items.text: The installation of MenuKeeper disables the MODX system setting package_installer_at_top, so that the Installer menu entry keeps its cached position instead of being pinned to the top of its menu. The previous value of that system setting is saved in menukeeper.package_installer_at_top_original and restored when MenuKeeper is uninstalled.
